title: Can I BEAT Killer King?
summary: Achievement hunt in normal 5-minute chess.com games vs similarly rated humans (~2100): earn the 'Killer King' award, which requires the checkmating move to be made by your king (e.g. king steps aside to give a discovered mate). Opponents resigning early spoil attempts.
rules: Challenge: the game only counts if you deliver checkmate with a king move (discovered mate by moving the king, or castling-mate).
win_condition: Checkmate where the final move is a king move ('Killer King' award).

opponent.name: Online humans (tyrenakka85 2113, Norunoc)
opponent.avatar_description: chess.com default avatars; awards grid (Killer Pawn/Knight/Bishop/Rook/Queen, Juggler, World Traveller).

board.theme_notes: chess.com green board; awards grid overlay.

visual_fx: 'Killer King' award icon (black king on red tile)
current_impl_issues: Mapped to 'shotgun' (lone king shoots) - wrong. Should be normal chess vs bot where only a king-move checkmate counts as a win.
evidence: rules.jsonl entry; frames (visual_a): chess.com awards grid, tyrenakka85 (2113), killer king award icon.
